scope: Public sealed runtime source and retained four-control evidence only
source_retention: After the optional stdin addition, the old source was reconstructed by reversing only that delta; both archived hashes independently match the pre-change reviewed identities. No rerun is claimed.
optional_stdin_review: Source-only ACK: str-or-None is passed directly to subprocess stdin without logging, hashing or file storage; payload sealing, loader and fixed clean environment are preserved. This addition was not part of controls02.

review.sealed_payload: Copy, apply WRITE/GROW/SHRINK/SEAL kernel seals, hash those sealed bytes, require ELF, execute that same inherited payload descriptor
review.execution: Pinned system ld-linux loads the sealed payload descriptor under the unchanged namespace policy
review.environment: Fixed PATH/LANG/TZ only; no caller LD_PRELOAD, LD_AUDIT or LD_LIBRARY_PATH inheritance
review.runtime_trust: System loader and shared libraries remain separate trusted runtime dependencies; the payload hash does not authenticate them
review.prior_failure: Original direct-memfd EACCES and its unsuccessful control result remain preserved; successful controls use a separately versioned 02 packet

limitations: Four public runtime controls do not establish native transaction validity, cryptographic correctness or private recovery
The application, never descriptor or RPC data, must select the executable and expected digest
This review does not approve a funded body, signing request or network replay
